candidates.prompt: Create ONE independently designed square 1024x1024 SEAMLESS tileable forest GRASS WITH FALLEN LEAVES ground material BASE COLOR / DIFFUSE ALBEDO texture for a bright miniature Chinese fantasy game. Strict flat orthographic top-down material scan, filled edge to edge by ground: NO perspective, horizon, terrain slope, landscape scene, specimen board, texture montage, border, frame or central subject. The setting is a FRESH CLEAR MORNING forest, but all actual morning sunlight is applied later in the engine: this image has UNIFORM NEUTRAL DIFFUSE illumination, no cast shadows, directional lighting, sun spots, rimlight, ambient-occlusion holes, bevel shading, dew drops, wet shine, specular gloss, haze, glow or vignette. Use lively clean moderate green around #58a24a / #71ad57, never dark muddy black, teal-purple neon, oversaturated fluorescent lawn or flat chart paper. The square is mostly a calm interconnected field of fine soft SHORT grass fibers, seen from exactly above, scaled modestly for a game floor: gentle blade detail spread evenly with subtle natural variations, without long standing grass clumps or big leaf-shaped shrubs. Scatter only small dry fallen leaves in restrained warm tan, ochre and pale yellow brown; grass must remain dominant, no piles or carpets of dead leaves. Leaves lie flat, matte and softly detailed, varying naturally in shape/orientation, NOT large isolated sticker icons or identical copied decorations. Keep both-axis repetition unobtrusive: same grass density and low-frequency tones at all edges, continue grass/leaf fragments naturally across opposing edges, no edge clear-margin border or grid. No dirt trail, paving, stones, branch logs, mushrooms, flowers, people, animals, buildings, objects, water, lettering, emblems, gore or vivid red. This is a single continuous opaque RGB ground material, no transparency, suitable for repeated planes. VARIANT 1: a fresh medium-light spring-green grass field with a fine crisscross weave of short narrow grass blades in #5f9f4c / #75b05a / #88b76a. Sparse tiny dry elongated willow-like and a few small oval leaves in pale warm tan #c5a162 and soft yellow ochre #c7ab65, dispersed loosely over the grass. Only about 3-5% leaf cover, no dense bunches. Leaves mostly about 2-4% of image width, grass blades much smaller. No broad bare spots, no sweeping bands. The emphasis is clear fine grass fiber and quiet scattered thin fallen leaves.

candidates.prompt: Edit the referenced grass ground material into a calmer, more readable game-floor ALBEDO while retaining its independent variant structure and scattered warm fallen leaves. The original is too wiry and extremely densely noisy. GENUINELY RE-DESIGN the grass detail: reduce the number of overlapping hair-thin threads by about two thirds and replace them with a quieter compact field of discernible slightly broader short soft matte grass blades over a continuous gentle GREEN ground tone. Broad smooth low-contrast color areas must exist between blade groups; no pinhole/black-pore microtexture, grit or sharpened thread noise. Keep native high-resolution detail but simplify the material structure itself; no soft-focus lens blur, no photographic lawn grain, no image compression artifacts. Tiny grass fibers should remain recognizable, modest for a miniature fantasy game, not standing tufts. Keep the grass clearly fresh natural GREEN with more neutral green chroma and less olive/yellow cast; no fluorescent neon or dark emerald-black. All light is uniform neutral diffuse: no directional shading, cast/leaf shadows, dew, wet specular, relief or sunbeam spots. Strict flat orthographic TOP DOWN BASE COLOR filled edge-to-edge with ground, no perspective, frame, border, central subject, grid, paths, rocks, objects, flowers, humans, text or water. The complete square must tile seamlessly in BOTH axes without coarse dark seams, boxed density changes or abruptly cut standout leaves; maintain consistent coarse grass density and tones across all four edges. Output one square 1024x1024 opaque high-resolution RGB material image. VARIANT1: Keep the sparse small slender tan fallen leaves (around3-5% cover), but make the background fresh meadow-green around #65a552 / #78af64 / #8bb974. Grass detail has soft short narrow blades, no large moss clumps. Leaves flat small and low-key, no dominant sticker.
